title: Alastor Lovely
blurb: One word, delivered with the warmth of a man reading a weather forecast in 1934. Lovely is Alastor at his most quotable: a compliment that sounds like a threat, or possibly a threat that sounds like a compliment, and the Hazbin Hotel fandom has never quite settled which. That ambiguity is why the clip gets used constantly in edits, TikToks and Discord servers, almost always in response to something that is not lovely at all. A second and a half of vintage-radio politeness with something unpleasant sitting underneath it.
